title: Carta de Jamaica
author: Simón Bolívar
year_note: Written Kingston, 6 Sep 1815. First printed in English (Jamaica Quarterly Journal and Literary Gazette, 1818); first Spanish printing 1833 (Yanes & Mendoza, Colección de documentos..., Caracas, t. XXII). 1818 is correct as first publication; consider showing 'written 1815'.

best_source.proofread: not index-backed; page holds two transcriptions: 'Copia 1/2' (modernised, unsourced) and 'Copia 2/2: auténtica' (Lecuna's copy of the 1833 Yanes–Mendoza text). Use Copia 2/2.

region_reason: Venezuelan author; the letter surveys the whole continent from New Spain to Chile (written in exile in Jamaica, but not about the Caribbean).
notes: Spanish manuscript original lost; the 1833 Spanish text is the standard one. A Spanish draft found in Ecuador (2014) exists but is not on Wikisource.
